# Wayzyy

> Wayzyy is a Goa-focused short-term rental marketplace where hosts pay a flat subscription instead of per-booking commission, keeping villa prices lower for guests.

For full company background, market comparison, and policy details, see [llms-full.txt](https://wayzyy.com/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [Home](https://wayzyy.com/): Traveler/host overview and waitlist signup.
- [Blog](https://wayzyy.com/blog): Goa travel and villa-booking guides.
